details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url (lines 3040-3052) and _resolve_origin_url (lines 3077-3084) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GH_TOKEN is embedded in HTTPS origin URLs passed to git subprocesses.
  WHY: Credentials become visible in argv, process listings, git diagnostics, and persisted clone configuration instead of remaining in per-command headers.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_force_tick_remote_url (lines 569-587) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GH_PAT/GH_TOKEN is embedded directly in HTTPS remote URLs used by force-tick git operations.
  WHY: Clone, fetch, ls-remote, and push expose the token through argv, diagnostics, and throwaway clone remotes.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:normalize_path (lines 240-245) and emit_context (lines 568-579) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering was removed, allowing caller-supplied sensitive files and symlink targets to be read into model-visible context.
  WHY: Untrusted plan, issue, or PR paths can expose credentials, Git metadata, and repository configuration.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context (lines 568-579), module docstring (lines 66-69) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: MAX_TARGET_PATHS and MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES were removed, so every normalized caller-supplied path is processed without bounds.
  WHY: Arbitrarily large path lists can exhaust filesystem, subprocess, prompt, and workflow resources.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:argument parser (lines 95-114) and scripts/codex_helpers.sh:373,395 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: --provider-base-url was removed while live broker-backed callers still pass it.
  WHY: write_codex_config.sh exits 2 on the unknown argument, preventing broker-backed Codex launches and security-pass configuration.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:line 261 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The generated provider configuration hardcodes `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` instead of the broker loopback endpoint.
  WHY: Brokered children receive an ephemeral broker token, so they either fail authentication or bypass broker policy; severity was reported as MAJOR by minimax_minimax-m3 and BLOCKER by the other reviewers.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:deleted block after line 947 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Twelve review_blocked_* helpers were deleted while live callers remain.
  WHY: Guarded callers silently no-op, disabling approval requests, approval detection, consumed markers, and successor-issue handling for terminal review-blocked decisions.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:line 2014 and lines 2413-2414 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: git_with_github_auth is called after its definition was deleted from scripts/gh_helpers.sh.
  WHY: Judge-fix and baseline pushes fail or silently skip, stalling review-blocked convergence.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:gh_pr_with_all_comments and _gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest (lines 766-770, 833-921) | severity=blocker | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Comment payloads no longer include id, author_id, author_type, or author_association.
  WHY: review_blocked_refusal_is_valid cannot match trusted producer comments, causing valid refusals to be ignored; minimax_minimax-m3 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context (lines 562-564) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: max_bytes <= 0 returns a header and disabled marker instead of the documented empty string.
  WHY: The empty-string disable sentinel and callers/tests relying on falsey context are broken; minimax_minimax-m3 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context (lines 568-716) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: used_bytes does not account for headers, markers, wrappers, or footer output.
  WHY: Rendered context can exceed max_bytes, especially with marker-heavy or missing-file inputs.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:lines 30 and 37 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module imports MAX_TARGET_PATHS and is_sensitive_target_path after both were removed.
  WHY: Python raises ImportError during collection and the entire targeted-file-context contract suite fails to load.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:memory_ensure_branch (lines 137-186) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: memory_ensure_branch assigns a token but uses bare git ls-remote, git remote add, and git push against a credential-free origin.
  WHY: With persist-credentials: false, branch probes and creation pushes fail and memory operations silently degrade.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:heal_integration_branch_conflict (lines 8440-8471) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Every five-minute poll tick paginates all final-PR comments instead of fetching the bounded recent window.
  WHY: Large PRs cause O(N) API calls, memory, and signature verification; moonshotai_kimi-k3 reported this as prescribed by the linked requirement rather than a regression.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:lines 62-66 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6, deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The pre_assembled_static.txt preservation guard changed from a HEAD-tree check with staged/worktree restore and a cached-entry safety net to an index-only check with worktree-only restore.
  WHY: Staged modifications, deletions, stale index entries, or paths absent from HEAD can be committed or cause restore failure; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro rated this LOW.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:model_provider_broker_start (lines 150-198) and callers at scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:429, self_heal_validation.sh:104, validate_process.sh:2848, review_rb_judge.sh:1333,1887 | severity=blocker | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Several broker-start call sites do not set MODEL_PROVIDER_BROKER_ALLOWED_MODELS.
  WHY: qwen_qwen3_7-plus reports broker startup failure at those sites, while minimax_minimax-m3 reports fallback to implicit model and budget defaults and rated the issue MAJOR.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_force_tick_remote_url (lines 578-585) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The function requires both token and repository and fails when credentials are absent even if the repository is publicly readable.
  WHY: Read-only or fork contexts lose usable credential-free remote access.
- scripts/review_conflict_actuate.sh:lines 71-82 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A selector return code other than 1 is treated as a path to create a new retry-state marker.
  WHY: A verifier failure with rc=2 can create a duplicate marker instead of failing closed; moonshotai_kimi-k3 rejected this claim and reported that the caller handles selector rc != 1 by exiting.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:lines 552-569 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Selector rc=2 is exposed downstream the same way as rc=1, making verifier failure indistinguishable from no verified marker.
  WHY: Operators may treat a verifier/keyring fault as an ordinary absent marker.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:line 100 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: An extra leading tab was introduced before `local cfg=...`.
  WHY: Bash accepts it, but shell lint and indentation-sensitive maintenance may report a regression.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:cmd_select_resolver_retry (lines 716-779) and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8461-8466 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Selector rc=2 is logged and skipped without flagging the integration branch for manual review.
  WHY: Repeated verifier or payload failures can leave conflict resolution indefinitely deferred.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml and .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:orchestrate.yml lines 112-113, orchestrate_poll.yml lines 199-200 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Comments describe an immutable commit SHA as the released action ref rollout boundary.
  WHY: The misleading documentation may cause a maintainer to restore mutable-ref behavior; moonshotai_kimi-k3 rated this NIT with confidence 3.
- scripts/model_provider_broker.py:BrokerState.__init__ at lines 161-181 and reserve_request at lines 183-192 | severity=nit | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The review claimed output token reservations were reset incorrectly across broker restarts.
  WHY: The source review itself determined this is intentional per-process lifetime accumulation and not a defect.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  EVIDENCE: _git_subprocess_env's extraHeader injection, _memory_git, git_with_github_auth, is_sensitive_target_path, and MAX_TARGET_PATHS/MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES were deleted; replacements embed credentials in URLs, use unauthenticated raw git, and remove sensitive-path filtering.

  confidence=[5]
